initContainers.name: wait-for-postgres
command:
echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..."
until nc -z postgres 5432; do
  echo "PostgreSQL unavailable, retrying..."
  sleep 3
done
echo "PostgreSQL is accepting connections."
